_note: Ability ranges (Champion Intel, docs/CHAMPION_INTEL.md, "Ranges"): what Data Dragon's `range` measures for each spell. The number shown is always Data Dragon's current one; a row applies only while Riot's spell id, range array and text hash (description and tooltip) are the ones in the row. kind: reach (shown as "Range 1,175"), global ("Global"), self (cast on the champion; not shown, by the owner's decision for Release 19), none (not the reach; not shown). reviewer: "automated draft" (the fixed rules of scripts/static/review-ability-ranges.mjs, high confidence only), "automated review" (docs/CHAMPION_INTEL.md, "Ranges": two independent reviewers, and two adjudicators where the rules differed) or "owner". why "unconfirmed": reviewed, and the review could not confirm Riot's number is the reach, so it is not shown. Rows are changed through pull requests: git history is the review log. No personal data.
process: Drafted by the fixed rules of scripts/static/review-ability-ranges.mjs from Data Dragon's numbers and Riot's descriptions and tooltips (only high-confidence drafts are ever written, as "automated draft"); then reviewed ("automated review"): two independent reviewers classify every spell from the same evidence without the draft; a reach or global is kept only where both say so and the draft agrees, or where a verifier and a skeptic both confirm it; any doubt is written as none, "unconfirmed", never shown. The team may confirm or change any row ("owner"). Data Dragon only: no wiki, no CommunityDragon.
